./app-shell.avoid: Do not import a router into the library.
./app-shell.a11y: Landmarks, skip link and current navigation are built in.

./charts.use: Prepared series, generic chart composition and synchronization.
./charts.avoid: Do not calculate indicators or import engine internals.
./charts.a11y: Provide a ChartDataTable alternate for canvas content.

./components/button.use: Actions and native button behavior; use buttonVariants for links.
./components/button.avoid: Do not use Button as a polymorphic link or assume asChild exists.

./components/input.use: Text input with shared control chrome and Field integration.
./components/input.avoid: Textarea and SearchInput are root exports, not this subpath.
./components/input.a11y: Pair with Field or provide an accessible name.

./components/select.avoid: Do not use for navigation or an action menu.
./components/select.a11y: Name the trigger via Field or aria-label.

./data-table.use: Semantic tables with controlled sorting, filtering and pagination.
./data-table.avoid: Not an editable grid or financial calculation engine.
./data-table.a11y: Native table, headers and labelled controls.

./experiences.use: Page-level assemblies: profile hero, social links, career timeline, project showcase, publication list, reading shelf, now section.
./experiences.avoid: Do not import a router, a data source or a chart engine; these are presentational and take their content as props.
./experiences.a11y: Landmarks, ordered lists, labelled links and progress meters are built in; pass localized strings for the empty and filter labels.

./financial-chart.use: Prepared OHLC and financial time series.
./financial-chart.avoid: Do not treat provider widgets as a source for prepared series.
./financial-chart.a11y: Use a semantic data alternate and preserve attribution.

./motion.use: Opt-in interaction effects under the motion intensity contract.
./motion.avoid: Do not animate every resting surface.
./motion.a11y: Respect reduced motion and preserve visible resting content.

./tradingview.avoid: Do not scrape or recolor provider internals.
./tradingview.a11y: Provider iframe and shadow content are outside LUC's a11y boundary.

./workspace.avoid: Not arbitrary docking or drag-and-drop dashboard layout.
./workspace.a11y: Resize separators expose keyboard and ARIA behavior.
